title: Generated export updates
responsibility: Adds missing named and type export lines to a project entry file.

inputs.name: applyExports.plans
inputs.description: Source-module export plans with optional named and type export names. An empty list avoids reading the entry file.

inputs.name: appendMissingExports.plans
inputs.description: Export plans to render as complete export lines; presence is checked by exact substring.

outputs.name: applyExports
outputs.description: Resolves true after writing changed src/index.ts, or false when no additions are needed.

outputs.name: appendMissingExports
outputs.description: Existing text unchanged when all lines are present, otherwise text with missing lines appended and a final newline.
